New Update

In a major anti drug operation, Basistha Police, led by Officer-in-Charge Kapil Pathak and assisted by JorabatPolice, seized a large quantity of suspected heroin from a dumper at Jorabat.

The dumper, bearing registration number AS 01 GC 7487, was travelling from Manipur towards Guwahati when police intercepted it during the operation.

According to reports, the suspected drugs were allegedly being transported using a specially created hidden chamber inside the vehicle’s oil tank. Police suspect that the concealed compartment was being used to transport the drugs into Guwahati.

During the search of the dumper, police reportedly recovered suspected heroin packed in 20 soap boxes from the hidden chamber inside the oil tank.

One person identified as Mohammad Farizuddin was arrested in connection with the seizure, a resident of Manipur.

Police are now investigating the source of the suspected heroin and its intended destination. Further investigation is underway to determine whether other individuals were involved in the alleged drug transportation operation.
